title: Reconcile approved remote-clone run bindings with the existing K3 verification-credit contract
outcome: Resolve the verification-credit boundary for approved independent-clone runs through the existing automatic K3 qualification/association owners and the Engram-owned admission contract. This optional boundary follow-up must not block the parent registration/observability fix and must not create a second credit producer or protocol.
acceptance: Run registration and remote observation alone grant no verification credit. Credit requires the supported Engram remote-admission contract, exact author claim/store/root binding and an acknowledged host-minted record; missing capability or invalid/stale binding yields an explicit uncredited/refused disposition without substituting a Central path or fabricating a verification.
disposal_reason: Explicit coordinator disposition: Fable2281/messagece99a7d3-7cbe-4173-8644-d9c39e0b2878 and independent decision c39ec6678b0f448eae6ab3ed44522c7e. The final existing K3 contract (Architect2 0b3df2da + Fable fd32f15e), together with Engram w-f1acdb37a014, owns remote qualification and verification association. This newly filed optional boundary child duplicates those owners; no separate credit item, producer, job binding, registry, import or protocol is kept under w5e2f. No child code, claim or execution occurred. Preserve parent registration/observability scope and current P0/Telegram implementation hold.
